Soon my Beloved told me: “It is me who made you to be deaf, so that you would not understand the iniquity those people are saying.” Oh, infinite goodness, I thank you so much; but tell me, when will it be that day when I will undergo martyrdom to defend you? You are everything, mercy and love and yet human beings mistreat you so much.

Oh, my Love, hold me tightly by the right hand // and then do with me what you want, for the expiation of the injuries they do to you my Good.

Oh, my Love, guide my pen, if you want me to write what you showed me and gave me in these days. He let me see into the hearts of certain persons and told me: “Each time that you will need to see into and penetrate certain hearts, you will see them like this. Whatever you ask of me, for the good of the souls that are with you and in your care, I will grant;

and the same applies to what you want for the priests.

Whatever you ask me to give you in prayer, I will give them.

You will distinguish clearly the good from the bad; I will let you feel the abhorrence when these will have ideas that offend chastity. You will feel it right away and will be warned;

doubt not that I will always be near you. There are many of them…Oh, what pain I felt! As regards false devotion, you will have special enlightenment so as to discern it well.”

Afterwards // I suffered much for this. Oh, my Good! The union with my God was so much that, having just begun to pray, I would immediately be absorbed in him, and I would see new things each time. Now, seated upon a mass of clouds all radiant, he tutored me, corrected me, made me know how I was to do his Work, in one word, how I should do everything. It seemed as if I was not alive, but someone was in me, working and living for me always. I saw a beautiful light continuously before me that, even when I could hear people speaking, if I did not control myself I would be enchanted by it, and they often thought I was foolish. Instead of being careful, I am always distracted and, in this way, it is not possible that the affairs of the Work go well. I laughed because certainly I wanted nothing. // oh, beatitude of a God, who makes me drunk without drinking! Yes, to suffer for you, dear Love. Give me the chalice of your bitterness, so that I may swallow it to the last lees and, in some way, give you relief.

New premonitions of God’s punishments

It was time of war; they were nearing Rome.14 The things I saw in the previous years were coming to my senses; in this way, I took courage to ask him if he had won the wicked and if Rome was taken. He showed me a big demon, enormous in size, and it was ahead and gaining. My Jesus allowed it and it was intriguing and winning. Oh, my Love, why don’t you crush it? He showed me that he allowed this because it would serve for punishment, but afterwards, in his time, he will make everything good, because this was needed even for those who appeared to be good. Oh, what pain I felt! What other punishment was still coming? Have mercy my God! What sights! // How they leave me discouraged!

Lying, as I said above, my sleep was a sweet union with my Beloved, who every moment made me exclaim: Oh, my God! I did not die, but I was consumed and burned. One night, when I was lying in the manner I said, it seemed to me as if I was about to sleep, but not like the other nights.

Suddenly I fell into a very powerful rapture, and I found myself in spirit in a church where my good was exposed during the day. I saw the church all lit up, bathed in light, an infinite number of angels adoring their God, my Beloved! I saw all the doors closed and found myself alone.

I drew near to the tabernacle and a host of angels stood there, the brilliant light dazzled me. I saw my Beloved in immense beauty, a fire blazed within me. As I recovered, I stayed bathed in that fire for long time and I had to force myself to bath the side of the heart in order // to recover.

Symbolic vision of hell, purgatory and heaven

Later, I fell asleep and slept for one hour; I woke up and it seemed to me that whatever I saw was before me. What joy I still had! I went to the church to receive Holy

Communion; as soon as I received my Good, I felt (I do not know what) a delight, and suddenly I was enraptured and saw two paths: one wide and the other one narrow. At the end of the wide path, there was a dark cave, without end, there I saw many people entering as if they were hurled down. It seemed as if the same cave swallowed them; what fear overtook me! At the end of the narrow path, many souls were entering, but all were serene. I saw souls, but they were like people. It did not happen as for the others who entered in the cave; the more they entered the least they could be seen. Oh, an interior voice told me: “This is hell and the other one purgatory.”

But, in a flight, I found myself in heaven and, in this sight, I stayed for longer time. When I recovered, I said:

How happy I am! // I lamented for the fire that burned me:

My Good, why don’t you keep me with you. You show me your heavenly dwelling and then again you keep me in the prison of this body. Oh Eternal Father, when will you grant me that grace of making me die a martyr for the faith? What can I do to make the whole world love you? Oh, my Love, consume me in your divine fire.

In ecstasy, I saw a soul standing before the throne of God, the Judge, who was in the act of condemning it. Oh, what a horrible state! What a screeching! What a torment! I remained shuddering! When I recovered, I did not dare to raise my eyes or say a single word to my Beloved. I felt it was I who deserved this condemnation, a thousand turbulences, and an abyss of disgrace. I saw myself covered with every iniquity. Oh, what a pain! Oh earth, why don’t you swallow me before // I disgust my Good? Oh, how I see myself shapeless! Oh, my Love, you are purity and sweetness par excellence and I am a mass of mud.

Oh, have mercy on me! What can I offer you, my God? When I offer you penances, these belong to you, because I am strong; I carry them out with the strength that you give and, in this way, they are fruits of your gifts. I see that my misery does not yield fruits from these gifts as they should merit.

Oh, my Love, I am agonizing and I am without comfort. Give me a drop of your balm, so that I can recover!

The oil for the sick. A dove upon her forehead

It is two years now since, on the eve of the Child Jesus’ birth, the Eternal Father himself taught me how to prepare certain oil that he blesses to anoint the sick. I saw a great healing taking place and, if people were not cured, it would soothe their pain and give them peace and a serene spirit to die well.

One day, as I was working, I saw a // very beautiful dove descending from above and it seemed to be coming straight to hit me on the forehead, but, as soon as it brushed by me, it disappeared. A few moments later, I saw a beautiful light. I was in the garden and I heard a strong voice that said: “You will be called to the visiting room by an uncloistered sister; be very, very careful.” In fact, it turned to be true and I tried to be very, very present to myself in answering certain questions which I was asked. After this, in the evening, I had the vision of two hearts of the Daughters of St. Anne, other visions of war, and frightful things of 1870.

The pain in the hands, feet and side. “Providence”

There are various days that I have a very strong pain on the side of the heart which seems to be rotten; so much is the sensation of pain that it is difficult even to support the smallest thing. Oh, and when I work! You can say, my Good, what my pain is and I am forced to keep the chain well down, because when it bumps against the wound, my Love, // the pain is so much that I faint. Only a cold bath relieves me a bit; many times even this is useless. Patience!15

When I lay on the cross to take a rest, I had already pain in the hands, feet and side. Extremely tired, I lay and extended my hands on the arm of the cross. Oh, as soon as I did this, the pain increased to a point that I was unmovable; the spasm was atrocious, but the consolation I felt in that state can not be described. I was unable to do anything, but to exclaim: Oh, my Beloved, how sweet your pain to me! Oh, I found this suffering immensely delicious because, in the spasm, I delight without compare! Some days ago I was very afflicted because I lacked the money to pay a bill, and they wanted to be paid immediately. My God, what providence! After much praying, when I finished, a few hours later a lady arrived bringing me what I needed and telling me that she // was sent by someone to bring for me that money. Whatever I did to find out who had sent her, she did not wish to say a thing, repeating to me: This person is anonymous, pray. And she left. I was deeply confused; soon I hastened to the chapel to thank my God for the providence he had deigned to send me.

Diabolic suggestions: “Your position is false!”

Last night, when I lay on the cross,16 – it was about one o’clock – I was not able to sleep and I was looking at the roof of the room. I had a strong feeling of pain. Suddenly I saw a big beast attached there; it was ugly, horrible; I had never seen it before and I do not know what to compare it to: round, with a human head, and it had very long (and some short) feet all around. For sometime it stayed stationary and then it ran towards me where I was lying. When it was almost upon me // it halted and disappeared. My God! It left me a very strong beating and unrest. If I was not very tired, I would wake up, but the tiredness overcame me and I slept. As I woke up, the impression was so much that it seemed I was seeing it still. It was coal-black; it left a black mark where it passed; it seemed as if it painted the wall black. Oh, what a pain! There was light, because I kept lit a big oil-lamp, which gave light to the room.

Another day I saw a soul who was in purgatory; it suffered much; it seemed as if it wanted to speak, but the pain was much; so it spoke in a low voice, but I did not understand. It came for the second time; then it told me everything.

There are already two nights; after midnight it seemed as if they come to my room and make artificial lights. Oh, what a pain! Truly diabolic arts! They are of every kind: on one side comes one of one color; on the other side one of a different color; dim lights like fireworks. // From my unrest, it could be understood that it is the ugly beast. Oh, my Love, your fires are very different! As a result, I was caught up by a strong temptation, horrible suggestions; though I see very clearly that it is diabolic work, the impression that I get is such that I am not able to reason.

He told me: “Pray hard that your Lord may make you die in which way you will finish suffering once for all; your position is false. You believe that you are doing well; instead, if you continue this way, you do bad. It is better for you to die and finish with everything. What did you do? You still have children, and what is your duty towards them?” It was as if I repeated to myself what Pius IX told me; that as for my children the Lord would take care of them, that I should think about the work of God.17

Oh, go away dragon! Yes, I see very clearly that it is temptation and it always takes advantage to attack me very much // when I am oppressed by afflictions and horrendous tribulations. It throws me into such melancholy that sometimes it seems I am agonizing and emptying my mind of all good thoughts. Alone, upset, in horrible temptations of every kind, except that one of chastity; from this one, I am free until now by God’s mercy. The oppression in my poor mind is such that it makes me faint. But I have the help of the Eternal Father; his powerful right hand raises me up, sustains me and always makes me victorious.

An inspired meditation on hell

A few days ago a friar appeared –I knew him from the habit. He was sitting above a light like a cloud; he did not allow me to see his face, but, from the dress, he was Father

Bernardo. I did not know why he kept his face in that kind of cloud. I asked him to bring for me something I expected;

I hope he will not let me down. Though he said nothing, I was happy, and within me peace took over…18

The other morning, // while the whole community was in the church and doing the meditation, some blows were heard and then they increased; the sisters were already frightened. I was in deep meditation; I only understood that it was the enemy aiming to disturb. The sound grew stronger, to a point that they were really disturbed. Then I woke up and ordered the dragon to leave immediately and to return to chains.

Immediately I continued a profound meditation on hell; a point on hell was already read before the event happened. I was not concentrating on the point, but soon with my mind I went to the wound of the left foot and there I rested in the sweet union with my Good. Oh, how much I enjoyed! But patience! I do not know how it came and what strength I got in doing that meditation on hell! Oh, those words were not mine but of Jesus! And wasn’t it the strength from him? As I ordered, that ugly obscene thing immediately left, but I did not speak loudly. No. //

“Be comforted, you will have all that you ask of me”

If I had not my Beloved God, with this heart19 of his, it would be impossible to stand in these days in the midst of many atrocious tribulations, slander and torments of every kind. Interiorly I delighted; my soul rejoiced in the consolation and I experienced a peace without compare. Oh, my Love! I saw many things in these days, and my Beloved ensured me that soon I will have great consolation. For a week, every time I lay down, certain monsters or demons appeared to me which terrified me, but they did not touch me.

One morning, after I recovered, I found the side of my heart swollen and my ribs… The swelling continued always. The rib was bent in such a way that the pain I felt was as if it were broken by the fire which burned within me; I had not otherwise but to bathe it always with cold water to have relief; I was without strength.

Oh, I cannot stand it anymore! I said. It seemed to me as if I was breathing my last. My God, when will you give me a moment of relief?

On 10 August the Blessed // Virgin appeared to me seated over a cloud; under her feet there was a religious and, since he kept his face turned to Mary, I was unable to identify him. I wait for something beautiful.

While lying down facing to the ground, flat with my forehead on the floor, the arms open in the sign of the cross, the Eternal Father, joy of my soul, said to me; “Be comforted, you will have all that you ask for.” Oh, my Love! Another time I was keeping forehead on the side of my Crucified

Jesus and praying that he may give me certain graces; there were many things I needed for his Work. He replied that I will always have all that I will need and he told me other things, but I do not write them down because it is not good to believe on the matters concerning religious persons and others…

“Lord, may your victim be consumed but never fail in your service”

Alas! The pain I felt on the side of my heart made me die, the spasm was such that it took away the strength; only water and the baths relieve me; but what can I do? The swelling where it is closed…20 My God, I am always more dead // than alive! I do not understand how certain good souls, who know God, fear so much suffering and try all the ways to be alleviated of it; they do not want to be convinced that it is the will of God and that through it he purifies their souls, which must go through it to become beautiful. It is true, my good, that, even for atrocious slanders and tribulations of every kind, humanity feels agony; but the soul delights, becomes beautiful in the midst of a stormy sea, where the waves throw it now on a rock and then into a depth among the stones. What worry this miserable humanity doesn’t feel, yet, the soul rejoices and is strengthened by the noble thought that its Being, the Godman, carried these pains: the slanders, the tribulations, the betrayals he had to suckle to the lees.

I was in the church with my eyes fixed on the tabernacle and I prayed that he may remove from me certain thoughts on a speech I had heard, but // they increased more; the speaker was a person who feared persecutions and, while he was speaking, I saw he was disturbed. Now, a voice told me: “You will tell him (and here, he named that person) that he will never have a share in the great tribulations: first of all because he has not the strength to sustain them. God has accepted your sacrifice and everything will be on your head; only you alone will undergo everything.”

After I heard this voice, God showed me many things; they were horrible things which would soon happen to me. But the strength he gave me was such that, at the sight of horrible things, I felt nothing of fear and I never failed to think about the Work of my Lord. Yes, may your victim be consumed, but never fail in your loving service.

Oh, my dear Love, the painful, agonizing suffering you announced did not delay to arrive. I am deprived of everything; I agonize; I feel I have strength. // It is not mine but of my Beloved, because without this I would fail.

The exchange of hearts made by Jesus

Today, a day of the Name of Mary. I spent the night in contemplation, always with Mary, my beloved Mother, and during the day I felt so much joy. This poor body had suffered cruelly; for that I felt pity, but I gave it nothing to relieve, because I was all taken by my Good and what I suffered was a delight. Mistreatments, more beatings…

without end and pretence. Oh, what pains are these? They spoke to me and I realized that they were thinking differently in their hearts; everything was contrary; these are very horrible pains. How much hypocrisy hurts the heart of Jesus! Patience!

Oh, my Love, I do nothing but suffer horrendously, as I see that they never start to observe the holy Rule, because without observance they will not become saints. How happy I would be if I could see // at least one who seriously takes the way of holiness becoming truly observant. My

God, this is a punishment for me.

Sorrowful as I was, I placed myself on the cross and lay;

the wood in the middle was shaking so much that it seemed there was something shaking it. It was very strong; it seemed there was someone shaking it. Really this was something new to me, but I was not worried at all.

Immediately I started making an act of love for my spiritual communion. This is what I usually do until I fall asleep. But a multitude of thoughts made me struggle horribly, though

I overcome them; and it was time for me to wake up. What weariness! During the day, I am not able to enumerate the spiritual communions I continued to do. Feeling abbandoned, I threw myself onto the side of my Good, where long ago he took away my heart, which was in this wretched breast of mine;21 so I stayed inside him, and, when I recovered, I was full // of peace and comfort, patience and resignation, though the adversities I find myself in cannot be numbered.

Apparition of Father Bernardo Clausi

This evening I feel a great desire to hang on the cross, which is straight, but the shaking of the bones make me fear; and the fear of falling again intimidates me.22 The desire for suffering pushes me to try to discipline myself until bleeding. After the last time – it might have been about a month ago -I saw myself dead under a cruel faint that overtook me and I do not even know for how many hours.

Last night how much I suffered on the cross! I lamented and called my Eternal Father to come to my help; the same pain made me to twist. Alas, my Eternal Father, I cannot bear anymore! Increase my pains; give me help to suffer as it pleases you, but I am dying!

I raised my head slightly, if it had been possible for me to turn, but, not being able to, I stopped immediately. My angel, Father Bernardo, appeared to me with his Madonnina // in his hand and standing he looked at me. My Father heal me! Help me to bear this atrocious suffering that makes me faint, for I can no more; but if it pleases my beloved Jesus, let it be. This I said when he disappeared; before I was not able to say or to feel anything. As he disappeared, as I said above, I started to entrust myself. It seems to me this was the fourth time that I saw him, if I am not mistaken; and one time is different from the other. I saw him in the chapel and in the sacristy, once he ran away quickly; the other time he remained for one or two minutes. These are the times I saw him with my eyes; then he was close to me while I received Holy Communion. Many times I heard his voice; sometimes he reproached me. I then felt much fear and worry. Then he comforted me, and what consolations he brought to me! Only the times when he rebuked me I remained upset; I was not discouraged because I was always // persuaded that it was the ugly monster who took that form.

For the rest, I always consulted him because, it seemed to me, that he was always close, as now I consult my cloud which, every time I need help it advises me, tells me what I must do and how to do it. I feel comforted in my adversities. Oh, last night I saw the beautiful thing that is in it. Oh, my Love, dear

Jesus, I feel no burden; only peace reigns in me. Everywhere

I turn to ask him something, I find it. Oh, my Love! Today I have strength of a slave. I work and nothing is heavy; I do not feel tired; I feel light; I feel like flying.

After meditation I had a trance and I was fully in my God;

I saw nothing, but I felt as if something great was nearing.

There was Father Bernardo, my angel; he told me to take care in doing what he said I should do without delay and immediately.23 //

“Poor me, that I am always in the midst of the world!”

In 15 October 1869, I did my Spiritual Exercises. Right from the first day the Eternal Father granted me a vision…

In my cell I was in contemplation, when my Eternal Father stretched out his right hand and gave me infinite graces. Oh, my Love! He taught me to distinguish clearly between the true and the false spirit; he gave me great consolations. Oh, my God! Oh, how happy the souls who have dedicated themselves to a contemplative life must be, in this and in eternal life! Poor me, for I am always in the midst of the world. Oh, my Love! Within three days I shall come out of my cell and shall be in the midst of the affairs of your Work, my Love.

It is right to do justice to truth, though in the midst of an abyss of business, I am never deprived of union with my God. Indeed for some time, since he has equipped me with this beloved treasure, a cloud,24 which I always see at my side, something beautiful. A being can // be seen within it, because, as I said above, I have seen it. Each time it becomes denser and rosier, and a voice comes from it that is bliss, and I am utterly absorbed in it. When I do not know what to do or answer, I consult it and it answers me; I stop and look at it and ask: Tell me, for I do not know what to say, my Being, my dear Love! I am convinced that he is there and I hear the voice. Oh, what it brings me, I do not know how to say, but it never reaches to enrapture me, because his word never lies: “No one will ever realize.” Oh, my sweet Love, God! He is the one, because everything that he suggests to me succeeds excellently and I find peace in tribulations which are without compare. In this way, taught by my Eternal Father, the Being of my life, Jesus, I obtain everything; everything succeeds for me perfectly according to his will. Oh, your servant desires nothing else, but to please you. Now I find myself in a moment // of anguish. I do not describe the sufferings, because charity does not allow it, being caused by…

3. EXPERIENCES SHE HAD FROM 1870 TO 1874

MS 1.1 – pp. 88-196

The pain of the stigmata. The bright cloud

In early January of 1870, I had very strong pains in my hands, feet and side; the pangs were terrible and I often ran to water over them to feel cooler. Oh, what a strain! And they never ceased, even if they attenuated a little during the day to let me work, and then, my Love!

One day they were so acute that once I was in my room, I looked at my feet where I had the sharpest pain; I found they had growths about two fingers high and I had to lie down because the pain increased. As soon as I was in bed, I fell into a state of rapture and enjoyed the most beautiful visions; I was given explanations about how to manage his Work, and some which I had received years before, when I was a young girl.

This evening, when I was in my study room writing, // my Good enraptured me; I stayed in him and had beautiful revelations of a person who spoke about me and told things about my poor spirit. Even the words he said, I seemed to hear; I saw where he was and even his position. I feared it was a deception, but it was not! My Good wanted to give me proof in such a way that I had no doubt. Oh, what a pain; the hurt I felt, my God!

For twenty days I cannot make another prayer except spiritual communions which I cannot number. I had a trance, but it did not bother me much; I thought it was caused by the many afflictions without compare that I had, but the more I dozed, the more delighted I was; and some painful thoughts which caused me suffering were drawn away from me. Finally I was surrounded by a beautiful light which was in my dear cloud; I felt much comfort and // I remained serene. I was always afraid that those who were with me could see it and it seemed to me almost impossible for this not to happen, but my Good never allowed it.

One day the voice which came from the cloud rebuked me, because I had my arms in a form of a cross and he did not like it that I should stay in that manner in front of people. Oh, what a pain! I asked him for forgiveness. Oh, what consolation I felt! I did much penance and accused myself. Oh, my Love, I am a monster of infamy! At the end of the penance, I felt within me such cheerfulness and strength that I do not know what I would have done for my Good.

Father Bernardo: “Go to Father Tornatore”

Today my angel Father Bernardo, appeared to me and showed me another foundation25 in this city of Piacenza and these will be cloistered nuns; I’d explain: it was a prophecy he uttered when he was with the Caracciolo family in Piacenza.

Today I heard the sound of the angels. // It was a day of suffering and pain, but I rejoiced at the fruits of these sufferings. While I was in the little chapel of St. Joseph and prayed, St. Anne appeared to me, and on her left was Father Bernardo. They were both very beautiful, shining with dazzling light. St. Anne was holding a book in her hand and was in the act of handing it to me. Father Bernardo said to me: “Go to Father Tornatore and tell him to give you the book he has for this foundation.” And he disappeared. I was filled with consolation, confidence and a holy courage. To go and to ask for the book? I feel ashamed; I will not go, no. In this way some days passed and he appeared to me again alone; he told me to go, but I did not go. The third time, he appeared to me serious, in an act of reproach; he asked me to go immediately. He said few words but they made me feel very bad. I was scared; I took courage and I went. I cannot // describe what I suffered. I told him as well as I could.

Another time, Father Bernardo came and told me to go to him as my director and confessor. I did not want to go at all, and again he appeared to me with a serious face and ordered me to go for confession and to tell him what I was feeling.

But alas, this obedience was very hard for me! I did it, though it was very much demanding of me.26

The oil blessed by the Eternal Father

How much consolation I felt one of these evenings when the chain made me a big wound on my right side. However, a certain fear came upon me that this pain does not please

Jesus; for the sake of prudence, it was better to remove it to heal the wound. But, after thinking that this could be the devil’s suggestion, I stopped and I prayed to my Eternal

Father. I said to him: If it pleases you that I keep it and you accept my wounds, listen to me in this… As soon as I finished that prayer, it was immediately granted. The wound became bigger // that the whole waist was formed a single wound and I promised to my Good that I will never remove the chain unless he commanded me.

During the novena of Christmas in 1870, what sweet days

I spent! Oh my Love, tell me, will you give me the oil blessed by you this year, my Eternal Father? As in the past, this will be used for the community and for the other sick. Oh, my Love! What did he reply? That it will have not only the effectiveness of the other, but it will be more miraculous.

Recovered, I stretched out on the ground, my forehead resting on the floor and my arms extended in the sign of the cross to thank him. Such great mercy and goodness he shows towards this slave of his, who deserves nothing for being the most disgraceful creature. May your mercy cover my iniquity and consume me with your love.

Alone, in the midst of a great Work!

Oh, the pains! Tribulations of every kind, horrendous slanders, the most cruel torture of pretence and finally cruel sufferings which I cannot describe because… // But my Eternal Father came to comfort me for three good times. He enraptured me into ecstasy; what great things he made me see and hear! But at the end of these, temptations turned up and I felt great pain. One was odd: to shun whatever brought union with God. Oh, my Love, am I to shun you? Dread!

I am very sad because for some days I did not see my cloud anymore; it disappeared because I am a monster of disgrace. My God, assist me; help me my Love! I am agonizing and paining; do not abandon me in this painful state, otherwise I will fall down without relief. Where are you, my cloud? Come, help me; alas, what have I done? Oh, how happy are those souls whose director comforts, assures, and relieves them; but me where am I? I am lost, my God; I am fainting. Where are you? What did I do? Weeping, I fell to the ground. Why don’t you swallow me, earth? In the midst // of many creatures, in such a vast Work, alone! All sides are closed.

Oh, blessed days, you’ve passed so swiftly! Though, even then, I did not miss the atrocious persecutions of every kind and toil without compare. My beloved Jesus was with me. The cross mended by his hands on my chest was sweet. Its weight was dear and every torture was precious to me. Now? I see cruel persons; they invent the cross and put it upon my chest and press it with all their strength. Oh, what have I done?

How can I amend my iniquity? They rage against me. What did I do? Forgiveness, my Good. My dearest cloud, come and tell me what I should do to be again with my love.

Oh, where am I? The troubles are interwoven in such a way that the ugly whisperer tells me I am out of the track, that this is not God’s design. Horrible temptation! I am in the dark, alone and loaded with every kind // of suffering.

I can say that they are tortures of hell. I turned a bit to think, when I had a minute for reasoning, about the mercy of my God and then, oh, no! Jesus will come to my help. I do not want to doubt it. Oh, have pity, my Good! Mary, help. Think of this slave; Mother, have pity on me; I feel fainting from much suffering. Tell me, where is Jesus? I was in such a horrible state; it was hard for me to pretend so that nobody could realize it and I had always to disguise and be cheerful, but I felt like dying. Death itself would have been a relief in comparison to the pain of having lost

Jesus, my Treasure, Life of my life. I saw my deaf and dumb child staying alone,27 the poor religious, the Work of the Lord which was spreading, // yes, well and rapidly as Pius IX said.

Ecstasy and divine consolations

I am unable to write because of the immense things of the

Work. Having come out from such painful state, here I am recovered and back in possession of my Good. There is no helpful reasoning when the soul is in a similar situation. Oh my Love! Perhaps it can never be reasoned, not even by saying it will pass and light will come; no, a deep pain cuts off the capacity to reason.

Now my Love grants me new things and in the raptures I receive a power of mind such that I am able to distinguish everything which belongs to God. He gives me freedom to act, so that I seem the first head capable of doing everything, I who am the most stupid of all the creatures who live on earth. I feel so much union that, throughout the rest of the day, I always feel joy and happiness. Oh, my Love!

In these ecstasies I always see new things. I saw myself // in a beautiful chalice, and, like a victim, my soul was being offered to the Eternal Father; it was surrounded by a brilliant light. I came to my senses, and I was provided with the strength to face all sacrifices which, in these days, not to say always, they are there.

In this week I felt a devouring fire, but in the battles I feared nothing, because I was always victorious. No creature brought me a thought of tribulation, no! Now I think of my Good who is in my chest. Oh, Love! And when I think of this, I feel something that, if I am not careful to turn off my mind, I would remain absorbed in him. I can say that I remain for some time in which I do not remember being alive, and, recovered from the ecstasy, I stay hours absorbed. Oh, earth, my exile, am I still stepping on you? Patience. This body I know I have it, only because I feel it suffers, but nothing more.

I stayed for some time, that when I was meditating upon the wound // of my Beloved, I wept and, always united in this way (because it was more union than meditation) hence one day, I saw it being healed. Oh, my Love, you are healed! A voice said to me: “You must think to remove from him other scars.”

Oh, my Love, yes, I would give my blood to alleviate you from the pains that sinners caused you (and me as the worst), but teach me and I will do everything! You well know what I do for the souls and I omit nothing for their conversion. Oh, what would I do!

New tribulations and anguishes of the spirit

Yesterday morning I was very disturbed, but I always remained tightly holding my Good and, as usual, with my mind I went to make a bit of adoration to Jesus in the Blessed

Sacrament in our chapels, now in one and then in the other.

But, no! Some beasts appeared to me, one different from the other; now one seemed falling upon me towards the face;

now it was falling on the wall and a big one with a long tail stayed more than the others. I observed where // it would finish; the big one disappeared without falling. I did not delay to know the meaning: new tribulations and pains, horrible anguishes of the spirit, came upon me.

Abandoned by any human comfort, I complained and called my Jesus: My Love, help me! My discomfort seemed to increase. Pity my Beloved! To whom shall I turn? Jesus has abandoned me because of my iniquities. My Love, you who alone know that I am on this earth because you want it, do not abandon me. Indeed, my Good came to my help and granted me many gifts. He showed me a soul who had a small diabolic spirit that invaded her intellect. Poor, she believed what she felt was a good spirit, but it was something else!

Pride had subtly mastered her in a way that everything she did was done for vainglory, which she would have never thought of doing. I suffered; I felt pain. Oh, what new pain agonized me! // In addition I had strong pains in the hands, feet and side, and from the wound of the heart, much living blood came out…28 Oh, my Love!

In the novena of the Blessed Virgin Mary, with the title

“Our Lady of the Vines”, I increased the penances as I could, but perhaps my dear Sovereign was not happy, because I was caught by atrocious spasms in the hands, feet and side. Oh, what pains! But I cannot omit saying that they gave me much delight. Oh, sweet, most delicious balm of pain! Mary, sweet

Mother, came to comfort me! She appeared to me with the Child in her arms. I was so strengthened in a singular way to bear very cruel and heavy tribulations. In this novena, Mary always granted me the conversion of a sinner; this was my greatest consolation.

Much fear overtook me, because of a person (superior)29 who has been in my room, though he saw nothing except, my dear Crucifix // and the crosses; he observed just in a little while, because he came out immediately. Oh, what horrible pains, what days, what times! Well, a strong temptation that this person might have said something overtook me and, worse, that he might have known something, because in some circumstances, like my grave sickness, many times I had received the Viaticum and the Holy Oil in bed, the stole… I was not able to hide certain things anymore, but, before those sisters close to me came to know, I handed them to the (superior). But I would have to write many things if I should narrate my poor, miserable life. Therefore, overtaken by a strong fear that he might have said something to others, I suffered. I had a cold sweat! Oh, what suffering! I who could have never wished that a human creature know what took place in me. Horrible pains! They caused me fever and a strong headache.

Alone, covered with wounds, exhausted by slanders and fatigue

I had no means to give food // to many sisters and children; I was not able to go for collection, because I had a strong pain in the liver, which was swollen because I was hurt and had a fever. What can I do? I went to weep at the foot of my Crucifix. What can I do? Why don’t you provide for your creatures? I am sick. Perhaps you are displeased with what I did; does it not please you?

While I was praying in this way there, a good provision of things came from afar. Oh, my Love! When will I be yours for eternity? “It is true; you will have everything you need.”

These were your words.

In those days, the darkness, the tribulations and pains were so many that it seemed everything was finished for me, and that, I would never find my Good. This is how I complained: What pains Jesus! Alone, covered with wounds, exhausted by slanders, fatigue and in the maximum lack of means; // the persecutions are the only bread you give me to restore me. But, my Good, the afflictions are so grave that I do not understand myself. They throw me into hell, into purgatory; one demon told me an abyss of things; I am alone!

It seems that whatever I did had gained hell for me. Weeping, I said to my Good: Well, if I merited this, come with me and then I will bear every pain with you. If I deserve purgatory, I will be there with you, not alone. Oh, why do you treat me this way, my Jesus? Why do you leave me in such an horrendous state? A loud voice said to me: “Why do you talk like this and complain so much? Look, do you see how to succeed in having all that you said?” A much wounded body appeared to me. “These are the penances of every kind and troubles he suffered. Only this will give you what you ask for.”

Oh, my Love, strike even more this wicked body, but do not leave me and I will surrender, but be always with me. //

Sometimes I even feel compassion for this donkey, when I see it exhausted. Oh, what happy days, when I was granted to see and hear great things beyond any telling! How can I describe heaven? I am not capable, because I am very stupid.

“I only held myself tightly to my Good”

I saw the road, which was full of tribulations and very disastrous; from every side was a mountain to be passed through and with terrible thorns. Nothing frightened me because, immediately at the top of this, I saw prepared for me great and beautiful things beyond any telling.

“You will have everything when you reach up there.” Oh, what magnificent treasures! All the pain I had experienced seemed nothing to me in comparison to the joy prepared for me and, for some time, it was impressed upon me that seemed to see always my Good; the union I continually felt was great. Oh, my Beloved, consume me. // Oh, with that fire I feel burning! My God, I cannot bear it anymore. I feel like fainting! Oh, when will that day come when you will open for me this prison and I will fly with you? That is not to escape suffering. No, because this is relief for me; in this state in which I am, only suffering gives me relief. Certainly this way of reasoning is understood by few: enjoyment in suffering, yes!

I suffer, I suffer much; it is very painful for me to work with this fire and other strong pains I feel; it seems to me that all, as they work, suffer as myself. I feel pain and, especially when I see the Daughters of St. Anne work, I suffer much more. Oh, how much I suffer! Poor, they had to suffer! Oh, certainly they will offer to dear Jesus their sufferings and they will bear them better than I and, in this way, my Beloved will accept them. Oh, my Love, teach me and make me suffer as it pleases you, // my dear Love.

Unable even to pray, I just held myself tightly to my Good, but, materially, I was not fully deprived, because I felt something of comfort. I needed to know certain occult things; my Love came and taught me like a master; he gave me the most sublime knowledge; he supported me in certain battles. I am alone, but I want no one, because my Good helps me, directs me, comforts me, gives me life; he lives for me; I do not live; it is he who lives in me. My cloud is always by me and is quite red; and, because it gives me suggestions and teaches me, I hear a voice that comes from it. Oh, sweetness without compare. What I feel, I cannot describe. Very frequently he talks to me, especially when I am in great trouble fighting with religious people, in injuries and slanders of every kind. Only one Jesus did not // allow, that one against chastity.

Savagely accused with false calumnies

1st day of January: What terrible thing I felt! The worst is coming from a Daughter of St. Anne. I was savagely accused with false calumnies. She gathered every kind of the most astute inventions that could be heard. I went on saying: My God, do with me what pleases you! But my

Good did not delay to come to my help, and such slanders were found to be untrue. Not only that, but my Love wanted to do so much against whatever was done to me that, as usual, I had to tell him: Enough, my Good, no more justifications.

Lesson of Jesus on the manner of loving the neighbor

On the day of St.Catherine, I had a beautiful lesson on how I should love my neighbour, including my children, how I should behave and the perfect equality with which I should treat all creatures and love all in him and for him. I must give creatures what has been given to me: save them and lead them // to love and serve him. Oh, my incomprehensible Love, what I feel! Oh, if I could have the pen of St.Catherine to be able to describe everything that you taught me! But I am very miserable. Oh, how I was absorbed after the lesson! I could say that if I could have everything I wish before me, or maybe, if had had the time for immediate writing I would have put everything down;

but, since I am always oppressed by work, how many things

I forgot to write! It is only now, which is very late at night, that I can write. But how can I remember everything in a moment? It is not possible. They will come to my mind even tomorrow, if my Beloved grants me. He is so good that he always teaches me or reproaches me. Oh, how strict he is in this! He tells me where I am lacking in the smallest things and he does not like it if I should fail to do something immediately; he reproaches me. Oh, what a pain // I feel! It is only you who see it, my Love!

Mary cannot give her the Child

The Blessed Virgin appeared to me with the Child in her arms; I asked her to give me the Child for a while and she answered: “I cannot.” Oh, what did I do Mary? Have mercy on me! She showed me the great adversities I had to undergo and that, I will have much tribulation. Recovered, I was melancholic, because I was pondering the reason why Mary did not give me Jesus, my Beloved, to hold him in my arms for a while, and I went on thinking. What have I done? Why did Mary say that she would not give him to me? I was so sorrowful that I had a headache, as if an iron has been fixed upon me, while interiorly I enjoyed peace and serenity. The pain that I might have done something that displeased my Good // gave me horrible pain. I went forth but I came back worse. I wept at the feet of Mary! My Mother, if I can not have comfort from any side, if I am a monster, which cannot leave the prison of this earth anymore, take me in your sojourn. No! Leave me on the cross to suffer till it pleases my Beloved.

“My Beloved, move aside because I am dying!”

Oh, blessed days! I always have my Love close to me; he helps me in my work; he speaks to me; he teaches me. Oh, how beautiful it is! Every pain of every kind, even the sufferings, and persecutions, bring me nothing; it seems to me as if I am a stone. Of all the things in the world, only one thing invades my mind. It is his Heart; it is my Love. I feel the weight of nothing! Oh, my Love, you are sufficient to absorb any pain, Love!

I had my arms all wounded because the iron had penetrated in the flesh and it was rotten; the pain was // without compare. But it did not help other than to increase in me the ardent desire of suffering. My Beloved continued to suggest to me new sufferings: as how to afflict more this disgraceful flesh, the horrendous beast of my donkey.

Not a single thought of mine is earthly. I work and act because my Good is with me. For four days and nights I saw him at my side; every now and then, while I work, I cannot help exclaiming: Alas, you are killing me! Have pity on me, my Beloved; move aside because I am dying! I abandon myself completely to him and my sleep is a continuous ecstasy. Oh, if God is with me, who can do anything against me? The whole world is nothing, less than nothing; for everything I see on earth is rotten. Oh, my Love, I feel consumed. I feel exhausted! //

In speaking I had something that I always stopped to consult him, because I was afraid of saying something which would displease him. For many years now, every morning, before I come out of the church, I say to my Beloved: I am going to work physically but spiritually I remain here to adore you; therefore speak for me; act for me; this tongue is no longer mine; move it to speak words which please you.

I go to do his Work. I will keep alive the faith and the promises given to me by my Beloved. There is neither a different thought nor an action against the will of my Beloved. I always try to let him act for me. Oh, Being of my life, Love that consumes me, only for you every pain is little!

Oh, Mary, tell me what I feel now! I feel like dying because I am burning; I feel what I am unable to explain; my Love, have mercy on me! //

Strict abstinence and mortifications of the body

I still see that he is not pleased with the food that I take, and I do not understand why. He does not explain himself clearly; since I am an ignorant and have no one. What should

I do? For I repeatedly wonder: What should I leave out? I only eat vegetables, a little pasta in my soup, and strictly without oil, no milk products, and no fruits, because when I was 25 I made vow to Mary that I would eat no more fruit, the thing I was so greedy for that one could say it was my only food. So what should I leave out? Tell me, my Love, what should I leave out? Perhaps I should do as I did that year when you did not allow me to eat, before you gave me the holy Rule. I took only a crumb of bread every 24 hours. My Love! Speak to me and teach me what I should do. After I said this, he answered me: “What you used to do. // Only bread, but twice a day.” He indicated to me the amount that would be sufficient for my sustenance, and I was to drink only water.

Oh, how sweet that life was to me, oblivious to everything, my Love alone was my blessing! Indifferent to everything, though beautiful and interesting it could be, there was nothing that concerned me; what hunger for suffering! I deny everything to this disgraceful body; I study to inflict suffering on it for any kind of need. I do not speak of thirst, which is horrible! As soon as I am exhausted, I bathe my hands not to give in, not to give it relief, no. Every kind of penance: a bodice with iron points, the arms… I do not speak of discipline because I do not know how to express it; I study the hardest and cruelest way to do it, but I always find myself in the midst of a host of affairs for the Work and, sometimes when I am able to retire in the room, … likewise at night. //

Between the longing for solitude and the demands of God’s Work

Oh, the thought of a desert is at maximum when I return from ecstasy… Oh, my Love, why do you leave me again on this earth? And a voice often said to me: “You must work!”

But, when I felt oppressed in this way searching for my Love, I said: My Love, let me go to a desert; there I will see only heaven, your home! What a pain it is to be always in the world and how much I must force myself; only you who can tell my worry! Oh, when I am in prayer, that is in contemplation, and it is time to go to work, everything is taken away from me and a voice tells me that it is time to go to work. As soon as I hear this, I go immediately in a flight, though it costs me much. Oh, yes, I can say that, my Beloved Jesus lives for me!

On some days, as soon as I stop, I find myself in a trance in an immense sweetness. I delight and it seems that this gives me strength. When I am in the church, a strong worry takes hold of me: that I suffer much, but my Beloved told me that it will finish quickly and everything will be changed. //

“Love, consume me on the altar of the sacrifice!”

2nd October: The afflictions oppressed me to a point that it seemed they wanted to remove from me the power of reason. Wherever I turned my head, I found only injuries;

however interiorly I rejoiced, because I knew that you, my Love, will not delay to come to my help, and this thought relieved me from every pain. Yes, my Love, every time you give me new consolations! – I go on thinking and it is sure

  • Oh, my Love! I said as I finished. Or else, when I am in fierce persecutions, my God comes to Comfort me. What can I do, if not to desire that others might come soon so that my Good might come to comfort me? Oh, his caresses!

Yes, this time a host without compare came. I was in such a terrible state that I felt a fire consuming me; I went close to the tabernacle where my All, the Being of my life, lives and, turning to the Eternal Father, I // said: If tribulations, humiliations and contempt make me rejoice and you always give me new consolations consuming me with love, why can’t I possess all the sufferings that are found in the world?

In this way I would remain fully in you alone. Oh, what will

I say of these days, because I am under terrible persecutions!

Oh, the pain in the hands, feet and side is so strong that the side of the heart is swollen and my ribs seem broken. My

Love makes me die, but I cannot bear it anymore! While I was like this, a voice said to me: “Rosa, do you know what I will give you, and you will be granted everything? If you only knew what you possess and what I gave you! But no, the hour is not yet; what you feel is the minimum of what you could experience.”

But these words have such sweetness that the delight I felt was indescribable. Only in him I felt everything great and sweet and in this Being everything is// absorbed; yes, everything is in him absorbed; the need to nourish oneself disappears; there is no need because, strengthened by a food so sweet, one is satisfied. One feels the pain, but does not suffer, because every pain is connected to an abyss of delight without compare.

He showed me what happened when the soul stood before the presence of God, the judge; what horrible fear! But I saw him as Spouse and Father. All souls come; love Jesus; do not offend him. For the love you have for creatures, teach me what I should do to make you known by all. A burning fire devoured me that I was unable to resist anymore. I would like to run through all the streets and shout out for everybody to love Jesus.

I flung my mouth to the ground and forcefully begged the Eternal Father to make me die a martyr to save the souls redeemed by him. I said: I am not your instrument whom you throw here and there as it pleases you? Therefore, let this blood be poured for once to the last drop to satisfy // your justice.

The tribulations in which I find myself are nothing else but sweetness to me. Love, consume me on the altar of sacrifice. Oh, suffering, you are too sweet for me. A fire consumes me. I feel my side as if I cannot raise it anymore; my bones seem to have become wax, because of their softness; the flesh is on fire, because inside it burns me as if a furnace was kept inside.

Meditation for the sisters.

Premonition about Napoleon III

In these days I am not allowed to do the meditation for the sisters in a loud voice. My Good allowed me to do it in a form of speech; I had no difficulty. It was a work like any other, as giving another lesson: a thing that, as soon as I recollected myself, I was absorbed. But, because he wanted it that way, he also gave me the strength and everything I needed. However, for two days now, it is not like that; as soon as I start meditation on the passion, // there my crucified

Love appears to me and shows me his wounds. Alas! I burst in an uncontrollable fit of weeping and I am not able to continue any more. To avoid being discovered, I stopped myself short, because the weeping continues. This is a balm for me in the tribulations in which I am found.

While I was sick, I saw a beautiful star and then a smaller one. On Saturday, when the pains subsided – not completely, but a bit - I was absorbed and I saw Father Bernardo, who was giving me the blessing with the Venerable and seemed to be in the midst of an immense light. When I recovered, the king I saw another time appeared to me; this time he was with a young man. It was clear who he was. I heard: Napoleon and his son. This remained impressed up on me: he looked at me with compassion as if he wanted to say: “Pray.” For three good times three matrons, one dressed in white, the other two were in blue, appeared to me. They were together with the two crowned.30 // I saw a matron who will bring me money and she was moved by my father St. Francis of Assisi.

For two days, the sorrow which was caused by the enemy’s insinuations, is diminished a bit. The enemy said that I am a suicidal for doing much penance, that I will soon die killing myself and I will have to give an account. Moreover, I never saw that my Good told me differently. I therefore thought that my Good was speaking. But from the restlessness I was experiencing, I understood that he was not the one and I always went repeating: My Good, don’t you like the penances? Weren’t you the one who suggested them to me? But everything disappeared; I felt a strong fire and I was enraptured in my Good, who assured me that it was the enemy who caused me much suffering.

She offers herself as a victim in all the sacrifices that are being made in all the altars of the world

While I was on a visit, I went for Mass; there were two priests // concelebrating: one was distracted, full of business and other things, and my Love showed me that the sacrifice was null.31 When the other one raised the Host, I saw the Blood of my Good. What a pain I felt for the first! What sweetness I felt for the second! I saw the blood when he was lowering the Holy Host and this I saw with my eyes.

While I was hearing Mass and offering the sacrifice on the altar to the Father, a very bright light appeared and a voice said to me: “God is pleased with this sacrifice you are making of yourself in the chalice, together with his beloved Son; but he would be even more pleased if you were to offer yourself as a victim in all the sacrifices that are being made on all the altars of the entire Catholic world.” And I wasted no time in doing this. No sooner had I done it than I was absorbed in God and my mind clearly saw all the sacrifices taking place, or about to take place, in all the Catholic churches. I received great joy, and so every morning I renewed this offering: My God, here is your victim, united with Jesus // your Son, to be sacrificed on the altar, in the chalice of blood which is offered to you as a victim for the expiation of sinners.

I meditated and, tuning to the Eternal Father, I asked that he may give me all the pains caused by the wounds which the cross caused to my Beloved, so that he may be relieved. But how can I take such a treasure when I am a monster of iniquity and misery? Mary, help me; teach me what I should do for my Love. Lying down on the cross, I offered my pain, but full of shame because I am nothing. I offered to him the penances and I was asking if they pleased him and I told him that they were fruits of his gifts, because I did everything with his strength. I certainly did not return what I received. Mary, my Mother, cover me with your mantle so that Jesus may not see my wickedness.

While I was like this, I felt a deep pain, as if there was something which did not please my God; what a dread; // what a pain! I was agonizing: My God, Eternal Father, heed me; on the bed of the cross, do not abandon me in such a cruel state. I am agonizing too much! He did not delay to come and everything disappeared from my mind; only the devouring fire consumed me. Oh, my Love! I said. For pity’s sake, never abandon me in such a horrible state! I am suffering, being consumed on the bed of the cross, but with you, my Love; I am always close to you. Oh, yes, suffering till the marrow of my bones is consumed, but with you; in this way such suffering becomes the best of all the comforts.

A strong thought of the horrible hell and of the poor souls who enter in it without any hope of coming out, overtook me. Before they enter, they see their indignant God, who condemns them. What a fright I felt inside me; and then an ardent desire that I was unable to control: to go into the streets and to tell all to be converted! After this fact something remained in me, I do not know what, that I had to force myself not to // make it public.

She bathes dressed to recover from the fainting of love

I find myself in the horrendous spiritual pains, because I do not see my Beloved for some days. I did not hear his delightful voice. Alas, what have I done, my Love, Being of my life, my Eternal Father? Oh, do not abandon me; come tell me what I have ever done! Oh, no, a thousand torments but not these, the others were even horrendous. Jesus you know it, I have no one but you, and, if you leave me in this state, I will die by pain.

Behold, my Love is with me. Oh, how many caresses he gave me! It would be too difficult to describe them: union, raptures, light to see those who torment me, why they did it and what motivated them. The slanders were terrible and here, the Holy Mother St. Anne comforted me saying: “My daughter, who has been more slandered than me? I had to bear the most precious fruit of the Eternal Father, and this gave me the strength and patience to tolerate everything.” //

The fire devoured me and I was not quick enough to reach my room. What can I do? If I did not bathe, I could faint and then, worse, they could have discovered my penances. For the rest, I had no one to trust in and I was unmovable for the terrible pains; the fire increased: My God, for pity’s sake let everything cease. I felt like weeping, such was the pain for fear of being discovered. I took courage and I said: I faint! In fact, that is what happened. I felt consumed, exhausted and, as a relief from the fainting, I asked to be bathed the way I was dressed. I said: Pour water upon me so that I can recover. They did this, I was relieved, and I was able to go to my room.

For three days now, right after Holy Communion, I fly to heaven. Oh, sweetness without compare! Yesterday my meditation was on the love of God, Being of my life. Oh, how little I have of this inexhaustible fountain. Still, yesterday in my thanksgiving, I was not able to say much because, after a long time, I was immediately absorbed in God. Oh, Love! Love // you are killing me! Oh, for pity’s sake, I am in the church; I am afraid they can realize it; wait until I will be in the room!

Light on the attitude of Pius IX regarding the Constitutions

Today the union with him was so strong that I always said: Move aside, for pity’s sake! He showed me many things: the graces he had prepared for me and the time when I will act freely. I saw clearly the reason for which certain graces are not obtained through the holy advocates, the glory that Father Bernardo has in heaven, and that he will be beatified; all doubts will be smoothed. He clearly showed me many things. In this way I passed to the Vatican and I saw the reason for which the holy Pope Pius IX did not reply to my card, that he thought much about it and he would have informed me through Cardinal Patrizi. That is what happened after few days.32 Oh, how many caresses and sweetness I received in these days from my Love! More than a usual. I was in the church, and this is what I had before I // entered: certain praises and courtesies, a thousand of these useless things. When I entered into the church, at the feet of my Beloved, I felt a certain repulsion and worry on what they did and said. Oh, what pain I felt! I would have jumped to make them laugh and be looked down upon; the repulsion and the pain I felt was such that I had no peace. I turned to my Good and I said: Why does the world appreciate so much honors, praises and being esteemed? Why do they say that they delight so much and search for them. Is it because they please them? How is it that they give me so much pain that I would hide under the ground, not to be seen anymore? I feel something interiorly which makes me suffer every time that I receive the smallest praise. Oh, Jesus, what do I feel // and why? He immediately answered: “My daughter, this is all my work and it was the first thing I placed in your heart: the repulsion to every worldly thing.” What I felt! I asked him many things and I had clarifications on everything. My Love, only you and nothing more!

Constant company of Father Bernardo

After the first day of the Triduum, I saw the Sacred Heart, that is, the name of Jesus, red as if it were written with blood; this sight stayed for long. Oh, sweetness! But I did not delay to be in the midst of horrendous pains; they were so terrible that I never knew how I could resist. They brought me mortal sweat. I heard certain strong voices of despair. Where am I? Mary, my beloved cloud, come to my help; I cannot bear it anymore!

Oh, yes, today my Love came to help me; he sent me my cloud to console me, but before it Father Bernardo came laughing. Today, // more than ever, my cloud is near me. Oh, Love, what consolation I feel that I faint! I prayed that it may move away so that I can work. The side of the heart; how much bathing! But it helped me very little. The pains in the feet and hands were added. Oh, what sweetness I felt for such pains!

Now, while I write, my angel Father Bernardo is near me; he brought me such cheerfulness. He likes that I write because he knows my Good wants it. But how can I do it, since I do not have a bit of time for breathing? You, tell me how I can do it, and where I can find the time! He laughs. Oh, he disappeared! What a spasm my small crucifix, which is inserted in the flesh, gives me today, my Good? The enemy immediately told me: “It will turn to gangrene and you will die!” But since Father Bernardo left me much cheerfulness, the words of this stupid filth do nothing to me! Moreover I have all the pains; even my head is aching and I write with difficulty. But I had a desire // to laugh and I was alone.

Again, I heard something, and it was Father Bernardo. I started laughing and I said: listen, I will laugh with you because I am alone. I asked him to give me one of the flowers that I saw at the feet of the Madonnina, his and all mine; they were roses and the loveliest of lilies. Why don’t you give me one? How avaricious you are! Yes, only one, so that I smell it and give it back to you; can you give it to me? This I said, always joking, because he also laughed. Oh, with your laughter, I fear that you will bring me - I don’t know what! But he said nothing; it seemed that his mission was to keep me company. The following night, he came to me with the Madonnina. Oh, what sweetness instantly, but after this he showed me all the troubles and sufferings that were in store:

at such a sight I trembled from head to foot and when I recovered I had a cold sweat… But Mary, with her dear gentle voice, consoled me…and told me: “After this you will have many // consoling things.”

Consoled and strengthened in this way, I felt no pain from my heavy penances. The pain of the small Crucifix did not give me spasms, and feeling them was sweetness without compare. Oh, beatitude without compare! Though covered with instruments I also put the crown on my head and I pressed it strongly in such a way that all the nerves of my head seemed to be tied up and even now I am feeling the consequences. But I experienced a strength that I cannot express. I can only say it was from my Good, because certainly it was not mine. Oh, my Eternal Father! The love I feel is so much that I faint!

Offering of penances and of other sufferings to the Eternal Father

Another evening, while I was in prayer, I felt an impulse to make this offering to the Eternal Father. This is what I said: My Eternal God, I offer you the two chains that I carry around the waist, particularly the big one; accept them for the sufferings that you, my beloved, Jesus had suffered when you were dragged down with heavy chains; while dragging you // they caused you bleeding. For the wounds, which these chains caused me, and for the blood that comes out and the strong pain that I feel, I beg you, my Good, free me from any earthly thought, and that, enraptured in you, I may breathe my last. Yes, the rest I take on the cross, the pain I suffer and the chain I keep under my head, the discipline until bleeding, and the fasting - all these, so that you, my

Eternal Father, may free me from the pains of purgatory and my soul may come to you in flight. The iron bars, which I keep under my knees while I pray, the meager food which I take so badly, the iron I keep in my arms and legs, the wounds caused by them, all these I offer you, so that you may grant me that your Institute may never fail in keeping up the holy Rule until the end of the world. For the penances I carry on my chest, grant me that my children may always be good Christians, Catholics, keeping faithfully the commandments of God and of the Mother Church and live in the fear of God. // My afflictions, the tribulations, the pains, the cruel troubles that I receive from the enemy, all these are for the conversion of the sinners; and, when I hung on the cross, the pains I carry in my hands and feet and side, these are for the Mother Church and the supreme Pontiff Pius IX.

On 15 April, while the Blessed Sacrament was exposed on the altar for the benediction, I saw the Holy Host bleeding, and then after some time it changed and stayed, only the left side was like a wound that bled! Of this last, the sight was brief.

Afflictions and temptations on penances

The afflictions of these days are without compare. The fears which assail me are of new kind: I feel strength as if someone is upon me that oppresses me and excites me to irritability. Oh, how astutely it goads me, pushes me to make acts of anxiety! At the end, I tightly held my Crucifix. Only your strength, my Good, will give me victory. What pains are these, my God! // I do not feel confident to speak, because soon it arouses in me something violent that I struggle to suppress myself; this causes me a severe head and stomach ache. How much pain I feel when some souls pretend in speaking and do nothing but search for subterfuge to hide the truth. Their hearts are so double that only by seeing them one feels strong torture that is unbelievable; I suffer a piercing pain. But when my Good grants me to speak with good souls, what I feel my God! I feel something that I always go on seeking.

In these days, I am very much afflicted because the enemy torments me strongly saying that what I suffer because of the penances is only taking away my life, and that, after I will exceedingly regret it, because I will discover that it was not the will of God. Oh, horrendous pains. I am alone; to whom should I disclose these terrible temptations? Furthermore, I was very upset by the same circumstances, because they were // always new. The spasms I felt when someone hurt me on the arms and also when I leaned it was the same. In the evening, when I lay on the cross, the iron penetrated more in the flesh and the wounds grew wide and deep. Oh, suffering without compare! But in your harshness I find my delight.

Alone in this fight I feel perplexed: will I be mistaken? What should I do, my Good; do not abandon me in this dull state, no, no. I heard a sweet voice saying: “Not only do I like them, but you should put on others, which would be the iron bars you carry on the arms; you should put them over the chain, the same measure, for this is what I want.”

But these last two words I did not hear well because, as soon as he said that, I would not hear. I drove it away and I rejected such a voice. But it was heard always more clearly, and I increasingly turned it away, to a point that a strong headache overtook me and I complained: How can I // stand? No, I believe it was the ugly monster; hardly having said that, the voice itself: “Try and you will see that you will feel nothing.” Oh, Jesus, my Good, what should I do? I will put it on when I sleep. But another contrast: “Think that you will be ill and, certainly, you will be able to do nothing; you will be good for nothing.” But no, the voice again with its usual sweetness: “Try, it is my will.” I then said: No, this voice is from my Good because I know it too well and the ugly one, who speaks in muffed tones, is the dragon.

Right away I put them on. Indeed I made myself these irons and then I put them on. They were on my skin, most atrociously pricking, and I felt nothing even that night, they were the sweetest of pains. Oh, sweet Love, what gift I had!

Oh, sweetness! Enraptured in him I enjoyed the most beautiful and dearly delightful illustrations. He taught me so many beautiful things // useful for the Work. A strong voice said to me: “Now you are dead. You have little to live.” Interiorly it gave me a bad feeling of fear. Oh, my Good, – I said - How many times I implored you to take me with you in a rapture of love, and now I fear! Oh, I understand well that this is only the enemy! To suffer and not to die, to give pleasure to my Beloved; to die because the soul desires it. But let in all, your holy will be done.

As I finished saying this, the voice of my Beloved said to me that he is with me. Oh, immediately I was invested with such strength that I went on saying within myself: A skeleton, covered with every kind of penances, has got the strength of a giant.

Discernment of truth or falsehood in people

I had a light which allowed me to see what was going on in others’ hearts. It narrated to me something: now of one sister and then of another. I saw very clearly the truth or falsity and I did not make mistakes. I do not speak // of what I feel in my side, because the ribs rise up, and this happened every time I was enraptured in my Good and also in the powerful union in which the fire blazed. Oh, what a struggle, suffering and delight! Oh, how useful these lights are to me! In a flash I see everything, when they pretend and assert what is false. Oh, what I feel! How I feel a burning and am strengthened to correct that weakness, because it offends my Good. Be quiet, heartless ones, why do you offend my dear Crucified? What has he done to you to offend him with such cruelty? I feel such a pain for this that, if it was not for charity’s sake, I would rush upon them to strike them. But Jesus is silent, through the heart of his immense mercy; he suffers and does not punish. Oh, my Love! I so often pray that you may relieve me of this pain which I feel when I hear // lies. Oh, what terrible pains are these!

The ugly monster tells me many things: that I am a ghost and I have no possibility to come out; it would take much effort if I have to describe what it tells me. But my Good sees my suffering and he will relieve me. A voice told me: “You should put on the bodice with iron points in honor of St.

Joseph.” (We were in his novena.)

The first word that I immediately replied was: I cannot! I have a severe stomachache and I do not feel like putting it on.

And with the torments Satan caused me, how can I stand?

Oh, my dear Love, why don’t you move, for pity’s sake? Oh, nobody comes to save me. My Love, where are you? Oh, what a strong apprehension I feel, because a bad voice said to me: “You deserved it!” The continuous torture that I feel is great, because I have people close to me // who say they are being affectionate, but instead try to betray me. I see clearly and it brings me much suffering! Only you, and everything for you, my Love!

Jesus: “You are dear to me more than all”

In ecstasy, I was surrounded by light and as if it were a mirror, if I can explain in this way. I saw my body with all the penances: every wound and injury issued a beautiful ray of light. Oh, it was beautiful! I rejoiced much and almost the whole night I stayed in ecstasy. After this I recovered and went for Holy Communion. What I felt, my Good! Your sweetness cannot be described! The first word I said as soon as I received him was: Oh, my Good, are you happy?

Immediately, with a dear voice that made me die of love, he told me: “Yes.” Your love: love me, my Beloved! He replied:

“You are dear to me more than all.” He told me so clearly that I remained absorbed in him because of sweetness.

Recovered, I was comforted, strong as a giant; I would have challenged the whole world, the persecutions // were sweetness for me and I was sure of doing everything for my Love; no fear could invade me anymore. No, God is with me;

who can be against me? I try every kind of sufferings; I search for them and I am never satisfied; I heap torments on this pig and I would tear it up into pieces and remake it.

During the day I went on repeating to myself: Dear Jesus, your word: “I love you more than all!” Oh, my sweet Jesus!

It was midnight and I went to the church tired, worn out by his Work and, kneeling with my head leaning on the wound of his back, I meditated. Interiorly I was afflicted because of certain cruel persecutions. A voice said to me: “These will soon finish like the others and you will have what you desire.” Tell me my Love, why don’t you grant it to me? He immediately answered: “I refused you nothing of what you asked.” Oh, sweetness, my paradise! //

I was always intent on focusing on the wound in his back and, in my mind I would have liked to heal it. Behold, my Good appeared to me so wounded, and I said to him: My dearest love, you are so wounded, what shall I do to dress your wounds? Oh, let me peel off my own skin and cover your wounds with it; I cannot bear it; I am dying of pain! And, as soon as I said this, his wound was healed. Oh, my Love, have you accepted this miserable flesh? And he disappeared. What strength he gave me; I felt as vigorous as though I had done nothing. It became clear and I always found myself in the church fortified by my Love to such an extent that I can say to him: Being of my life, because I live not with my own life but it is my Good who lives for me.

My Good will care for “providence”

11 February: How many beautiful lessons he gave me! He explained to me certain doubts I had; he showed me what I will go through… // I slept very little, if it can be called sleep, because I was always with my Beloved. I enjoyed paradise, sweetest union. I saw that he granted me the grace I asked from him, for he showed it to me a beforehand. I did a novena to the Blessed Trinity that he may send for me a providence, because I was in need. I was enraptured and he showed me someone with a small sack of gold in her/his hand and she/he was bringing it to me. It was true; the person came immediately. I was so convinced that my Good would take care of the providence, such that I prayed no more.

Suffering caused by Father Tornatore

In these days I had to fight with the enemy: angry Satan, the obscene pig, was strangling me. The fight was so strong that I was agonizing. My Beloved did not delay to come to defend me. Since Father Tornatore stayed always in the house, he became aware of something, // and more so when he had in mind to reproach me for what I was telling him. He therefore realized something but not everything, and he almost, for I feared, I was even sure, that he said something.

The pain was such that it brought me fever and I was very tortured, because my Good showed me very clearly what he said. I told my Good that I would be silent about everything.

But many times with the order of the superior;33 what pain my God! The fear I had of being sent out and away was cruel. What pains are these? Only my Good could describe them. I had doubts and this is what I said to my Good:

explain to me this point. He gave me a beautiful lesson and I remained in peace.

Vision of Jesus in the image of a meek lamb

At Nizza, in the hospital,34 I saw a beautiful star: Alas, a superior? // No, but it was very beautiful. Why do you move around me? What do you want? Could it be the passing away to heaven of a good soul? I was given no reply.

I turned and saw a white cross: Who is dying or is dead? I heard nothing. I spent a sorrowful night; I felt exhausted and I always asked: Who will die? The next day I went to Piacenza and I found a good sister had died. I wanted to have Mass for her, but as soon as I entered the church I felt the thrust to recite the Laudate. Where are you rejoicing, beautiful soul? Pray for me and for the Work of the Holy Mother, St.Anne! A voice said to me: “In purgatory I had only few minutes.”

Oh, how I felt relieved from that apprehension! But dryness seized me, as if I was unable either to pray nor to think. However, all at once, I felt someone approaching. Oh, he was my Good, Jesus, my Beloved! I felt myself clinging to him, and I stayed absorbed in my Good.

I saw a man holding //a knife in his hand, in an act of thrusting it into my throat; he had his face turned in a manner that I was not able to identify him. In an angry voice he said: “Give up this work or I will kill you.” But I was with my Good and, so peacefully, I turned to my Good and said: What should I do? “Do not be afraid,” he replied. Oh, my dear Love!

When I recovered, I understood well that it was the devil’s work to frighten me. It will never happen. Even if I have to suffer all the martyrdoms of this earth, I will always be your slave and you, my Beloved.
