A voice replied to me: “Look at how meek I am!” And a lamb appeared to me; it was wounded in the chest and dripping with blood! How this sight shocked me! He caressed me; his nearness made me die of Love. The fire in the part near my heart was violent and it stayed a long time. Alas, my Love, I am dying! Oh, my Beloved Lamb, // move away, I feel the burning too much. No, for pity’s sake, leave me; I am dying; have pity, my Love! He gave me a kiss on my forehead, as lambs do, and he vanished. What I felt while it caressed me! It put the two legs on my neck. Oh, who could describe what I felt? As soon as he left, I turned to water for bathing; otherwise, I could not stand; and I renewed my protests. I was so comforted, full of joy that I would run to shout to all that they may love Jesus, the only Good, because only from him they can find every kind of happiness. I had a continued and lively presence of God.

“My Love speaks for me”

Out of God’s mercy, I always find myself in his presence, and now, more than a usual; this happens to me when I receive the caresses of my Good. There are moments in which I feel, coming out of my mouth, words in reply to the affairs of his Work, and, in this way, // I never think what I should say, because my Love speaks for me. Sometimes I can say that I listen to the same words with pleasure, as if someone else is speaking; and if sometimes they don’t come, then I say: Jesus, what should I say? Immediately I feel words coming out of me which are not certainly mine; he works and speaks in me. I could say that it is a rest for me, because in him I enjoy his delights.

This evening I was doing the examination of conscience and I said: My Love, with an abyss of affairs sustained and a thousand businesses, I feel tired. Immediately the enemy said: “You are certainly full of sins and you had given bad example.” I felt so upset that soon I turned to my Good.

Alas, my Jesus! But nothing came. My worry was becoming stronger; it seemed to // me that I committed too many sins, but I did not know what they were because nothing was coming to my mind and the worry increased. A clear voice said to me: “Have I therefore sinned?” It was a gentle voice that filled me with joy; soon I felt invaded with a peace that has no comparison. Oh, the voice was of my Good and immediately I said: You cannot sin! And again: “Do I not live for you?” Oh, at this I truly felt… and I was enraptured;

again he said to me: “Can you commit evil act?” These lively and sweet words gave me certainty that I had nothing more to fear; only love is my pasture.

It is some days now that he suggests to me where I should go to find providence for his Work; he instructs me how I should do this with the serenity of paradise. As soon as I realize something which pleases him for his beloved Work, immediately I do // it without bothering about the pains that I could face, provided I can offer you this, my Love! Oh, yes, I see how much you love creatures, but they disappoint you! You are fully love in yourself! A voice said to me: “Yes, I love human beings immensely.” In telling me this, he came close to me. Oh, Sweetness, Love, you consume me.

Vision of the Child Jesus and of Our Lady

On 8 September: Oh, my Love! Absorbed in him, I saw the Child Jesus approaching me and I watched. I asked the angels to cover me so that Jesus may not see me disfigured. My Love, your charity is without compare. Oh, how many things I understood! But he left me languish and I went to receive Holy Communion. As soon as I received my Good, I was enraptured in him. I saw the church all resplendent: the good souls who had received him and many angels close // to the creatures who had communicated; they were in the act of adoration. There was much light in the whole church. The light that surrounded the ciborium was greater and, in this light, I saw the Queen of heaven and of earth surrounded by angels and seraphim.

Oh, how much I begged her that she may enrapture me for ever in such a beautiful moment! Now I asked her that she may grant me, as a Mother, and then I called her my beloved Queen. Oh, if she would move, for pity’s sake, for I would not stand such a painful state. Mary! When I recovered, oh, beloved Mother, what I felt! I was consumed with love!

Oh, if I could offer to you something which pleases you, my Love! I would certainly do it, but I have nothing, only the penances. They are fruits of your strength, of your will. I have only the sufferings, which this ugly pig of a body feels and they are nothing. The wounds, the pains // that you granted me in my hands, feet and side, these are treasures; as for me I have nothing. I am the most miserable, but you, my Good, give me so much! The fire subsided a bit and I understood the reason.

Many days and months without writing

The work was so much that it did not give us a minute of breath; it always gave us thought. My God, neither during daytime nor at night was there a moment to rest.

The efforts, which should have been made by twenty people, were made by eight people. What pains from all sides! The tribulations were without compare. I was with less fire, but I suffered much. In this way, at night, instead of staying with my Beloved, he left me cold. He ordered me to stand up from kneeling and to go to work. What pains were these for me! But I always obeyed and went, // without sparing myself. I was all for my Good. In this way

I stayed for many days and months without writing;

however he justly rebuked me for this, but so gently and sweetly that I did not know how to answer. I only said:

Forgive me, my God! “Tell me, why don’t you write?” Oh, my Love, how can I do it? “At night, write the notes for half an hour, and then you will resume in time.” Oh, sweetness without compare! Yes, my Good, I shall not delay.

But at night I prayed and wrote to replay to the outsiders and to the sisters, because many times I was alone. I had to keep the accounts, me as an ignorant, a true beast; I felt compassion for myself. I started writing: What should I say, my Love? That I have your strength which is without compare, but I have no caresses: only pains and continuous troubles. While things went like this, in receiving Holy

Communion I said: My Good, // for pity’s sake, tell me: what does it mean, this deep melancholy that I feel? There, a skeleton appeared to me. Oh, my God, who is this? Who are you? It gave no answer. I was not able to understand whom it resembled. What a pain, my God! During the day I continued to ask myself: Who can it ever be? But I found nothing that could indicate someone. Patience! I continued with my melancholy. It is true that nobody was aware, but I had to force myself so that nobody could realize. At the same time, I suffered much, but I cannot express myself further.

A star was added, yes, but it went around me. Who will die, my Good? The sisters? This is a notice. For pity’s sake, my God; don’t you see there is much need for your daughters? Oh, dear Holy Mother, St. Anne, take care! //

A mysterious ecstasy

That cloud which, I used to see frequently, I now see more rarely. The other night it appeared to me brighter than usual. While it was in front of me and dazzling me, it melted away and I saw my Beloved. He was inside it, infinitely beautiful, a splendor without equal! What he told me; what he brought me! He soothed all my pains; he made me forget everything. My tribulations, although they were many, were all forgotten. Only my Love had absorbed everything. He left me something I cannot explain, but what I feel inside me makes me die of love. Tribulations and trials were raining down from all sides, but could I feel them? Nothing! In my Love, all was absorbed by the sweetness of his love. Yes, strike! This donkey is strong and my soul enjoys much.

Last night, as usual, I took my rest on the cross. I experienced such calm that I cannot describe it. I felt enraptured and I went. Where? To a room of a sick person.// But I will not write down everything, because it would be too much and I fear they may suspect as they read. I will limit myself to saying that the sick one complained and was very disturbed in her conscience and an aged woman comforted her. At the same time, the aged woman gave me a child. Oh, my Love, in swaddling clothes? Well, it had three big drops of sweat and I wiped them: two were very big and one a bit smaller. While I did this he smiled at me, as if to thank me; he was very beautiful! He gave again that smile, which delighted me, and disappeared. Afterwards, my Good explained everything to me.

I cannot express the sweetness of love that it brought me; I cannot write everything, because my love did not tell me. As I loosened my wrist, because I felt something, I looked and I saw a scar in the arm. While I was like that, a strong but a sweet voice told me:// “Put on other irons, because I desire it.” I did not want to heed. I was tired, but he continued so much that I made new ones and I put them on. Oh, what peace, what consolation I felt! I always wanted to know the explanation of the three drops of the child, but I struggled for long time; he told me, but he imposed me not to write.

Oh, what I ever feel in these days! What sweetness, my God! Jesus gave me strength with his caresses. Now I am in the midst of horrendous pains of every kind; the tribulations on all sides have no equal, and Jesus leaves me alone. Oh, Eternal Father, come to my help to combat the enemy, the creatures and, most of all, the tribulations caused by priests for these torment me - and those by the Bishops. Oh, my Love, only you could say of what kind is my suffering! I feel something sustaining me. // It gives me courage and strength to bear everything with peace and resignation.35

“My Good, let me live to suffer!”

On the day of Corpus Domini, I was absorbed in God, and what I saw? My Good, little, appeared to me with his arms open, but afterwards he withdrew. Oh, my Love, what sweetness you made me feel. In the same way, in my room with my arms open on the floor, I prayed to my God; the fire burned me. Yes, my Love, consume me, but, for pity’s sake, that the world may never suspect the least thing. Oh, it would make me too sorrowful; only the thought brings me a cruel torment. Oh, my Love, make me die so that once I may be taken away from the abode of this world where I am suffering tortures. Oh, no; what am I saying; forgive me, my Good! Let me live to suffer! Forgive those expressions of mine dictated by the ardent desire to be with you, but no, to live to give you pleasure in continuous suffering. // Oh, I am burning; all of a sudden my little Jesus, together with a small angel in an act of adoring him, appeared to me.

Now, as I write, I hardly move the pen. Oh, my Good, I would leave and with you I would go to ecstasy to enjoy my Love. He wanted me even to write down for whom I have been offering my fasting for years! I am smaller than an insect and so I do things in a smaller way, and I hope my Good will accept even these ineptitudes.

Monday, is for the souls in purgatory; Tuesday, for sinners and for those who are dying; Wednesday, for St. Francis of Assisi and St. Joseph; Thursday, I dedicate to the Eternal Father in honor of Jesus in the Sacrament; Friday, for my children so that he may keep them good Christians for me; Saturday, is in honor of Mary; Sunday, for the Holy Church and for the Supreme Pontiff, Cardinals and Bishops.

Why do you want me to write even this? That’s what I said, but I was not given an answer. I had only great consolation at having written it and, a fire that consumed me. // A voice said to me to stay at the foot of my Crucifix and not at his side, as I usually stayed, leaning with my forehead, infinite times absorbed and I received beautiful lessons. At this announcement I was troubled, but I obeyed soon and tightly holding his feet to the chest I wept. Oh, I am allowed to kiss only your blessed feet. Alas, what have I done! And I wept very much. Oh, you punish me in this way, I understand, because I am not worthy! At your blessed feet I will give vent to my pain and I will not leave until I obtain your forgiveness. Jesus, pity! I did not dare to look at him, weeping suffocated me. Pity, my Love, I left everything for you: children, father, and mother, all. What have I done? I cannot bear it anymore; give me all the punishments, but not this.

I heard a voice and I stood. He gave me the gift of not having the need of sleep, which I prayed for, and asked him for long time and I suffered much. I was agonizing; I dozed // on my way to the sick. He told me to continue to eat only bread that he will continue to hide me, and that is what happened. Oh, what mercy! I always went for lunch; I did not eat, but only the soup, I left; nobody was aware; the remaining

I put into my apron and then I gave it to the sick. They never realized! What mercy! When he wants something, he knows how to cover it so that nobody sees. I delighted with joy.

After Holy Communion, I said to him: My Love, you did not disdain to come down in this chest; let me hear the prayers of the angels in their adoration! Alas, I understand the reason for which I do not hear those harmonious voices.

My stinking ears, full of every kind of worldly sound, have reduced me to this.

I was // so discouraged; I saw and felt nothing; only an interior fear invaded me. Oh, my Love, for pity’s sake, do not leave me like this. I am quite crazy! In the midst of the spasms and the aridity, give me strength to be able to bear it.

Oh, the side, only in receiving him, I do not know what I felt.

But, if you did not disdain to enter into this heart to make it your tabernacle, why do you not answer me something? Oh, speak to me; what a pain!

“He showed me what would happen at my death”

At night he came to console me; he showed me what would happen at my death: what they will do to me and how they will dress me. The one who will have ascendancy over me, will be the one as my last director, whom I shall obey, but he will take care not to order me to do things he has not felt himself. The tertiary habit will be my habit and the rest will be of St. Anne. The one who will dress me // will try to hide some stuff, but she will be discovered.36 Oh, I interrupt because the things he told me are very beautiful, and they will take place not for my merits but only for the mercy of God, my Love, and my All. Oh, blessed sojourn, when will I dwell in you?

The torment for feeling abandoned by God

Oh, how I have been disgraceful? I cannot have peace. In two days, what I did! And Jesus, goodness without equal, how he taught me well. Yes, I write everything, my Love; it will help me as a lesson, if unfortunately I will fall back in that painful depression. In this writing I will have some comfort. The state in which I found myself was such that I was indolent. I do not know how. Instead of searching immediately for my Love so that he may give me help, I abandoned myself to be possessed by a state of languish. I was fully abandoned to a strong affliction that increased the anguish in me; the pain was cruel.

Abandoned in this way, humanity was cherished, because in the depression nothing seemed to me to be good, // capable to make me reason and to be alleviated from such a painful state. Only gloom accompanied my pain. My Good came and caressed me. Alas, what did I do! I avoided him, turning away my eyes disdainfully; I wanted neither to see, nor to hear. My cloud came and I did the same; the sorrow I feel for this agonizing pain is so much that I do not want to hear anything.

I paused. Alas, I fell into a terrible temptation of despair: the pain of having displeased the essence of my life and the realization that my Love might have abandoned me for this! Pain without compare! I was agonizing. Oh, the sword that pierced my chest! I called him; I asked for forgiveness, but nothing came! The pain was so strong that I felt as if I have my body under a press; my soul was writhing. The pains I suffered were of all kinds and so many that I fainted. When I recovered, my first words were: I have lost my God!

For three // days I was in such a painful state that I shall never forget them. On the fourth day, after communion, a sweet voice said to me: “Rosa, how you made me suffer!” I understood it was the voice of my Beloved. Alas, it is true! Forgive me; what did I do? “Your fidgets and saying that you do not want to have anything to do with my Work. You distressed me!”

I remained, I cannot say how, because one must experience it in order to know what it is like. What a pain it was! But I remained in ecstasy. It was true that I said such things in pain.

Mean while, my soul was ridding itself of such a dense cloud and was returning to its original state: peace and resignation in adversity, untied from that spirit which kept me bound in such a cruel state. When I recovered I felt I was someone else and all those words above, which were told me by my Good, were repeated to me one by one. Oh, my Beloved, did I make you suffer? What a horrible thought! I made a new strong resolutions: that with his help, I will never fall again. May death come to me soon, rather than to commit such a thing. //

The next day, the Eternal Father gave me various lessons on this point; he showed me that such pain resembled the pains of hell. Jesus told me this: “You see, my beloved, you rejected me and avoided my sight, the same with the cloud, where I was. I called you many times and you always turned else where and you drove me away. Then I abandoned you;

you searched for me, but you did not find me anymore. This is how the damned are, they will not meet me.” Oh, only thinking about it I feel trembling! Certainly, I will never forget it. Oh my Good, forget what I did. Oh, didn’t I do the penances for this?

Jesus: “My beloved, your pains are mine”

On the eve of Christmas, I saw certain false hearts; they brought me immense pain to a point that I was sweating. I suffered much but my cloud came to comfort me because I suffered horrendously. // He said to me: “My dear, courage!”

And he came very close to me. I stayed absorbed in my God in contemplation. When I recovered, the thought used to flash back before me and gave me much pain. The torment was very strong and caused me breathlessness because I had received certain afflictions and mistreatments. I went on saying to myself: it might be my mischievousness and wickedness which confuses my mind. My Good, I am afraid that it is the angel of darkness that disturbs me. It was true, it could be said that my spirit delights, because to suffer in union with my Good is a consolation. Why then do I feel much pain, my Love? My handsome Beloved appeared to me all wounded; he said to me: “My dearly beloved - and he came closer - look, for everything they do to you, I receive the same pain; your sufferings are mine. Do you want to know why you suffer so much seeing your daughters // and those who are close to you acting so maliciously? Be calm, there is nothing human in it; but since you are destined to suffer painfully for anything that offends me, you feel even more than what appears.” I could not say anything, but without speaking he stayed close to me for about three minutes and then disappeared; but he made me understand everything clearly.

I made a strong complaint and said: My God, my Love, my All, why shouldn’t I force myself and let all the others do as it pleases them? After all, those who guide these souls are religious and they should be thoughtful; regarding this I should not have much anxiety, let them take care. A voice that I heard very well said: “My Work would suffer; it is me who works for you.” Oh, what a pain! Oh, my Love, I have no intention of avoiding either pain, suffering or sacrifices or any kind of martyrdom; let every sword turn // towards me and pierce me as it pleases you; I am your victim. A voice said to me: “Yes, you are!”

In this way, every time they make me suffer much I said: My Good, do you suffer? Alas, no, to me all the pains, not to you my Beloved! I knew that he shared in all the smallest things that happed to me - as he told me one day while I feared certain things which happened - he said to me: “Do not be afraid, I am always with you when you work, even in the smallest things.” Oh, my Love, what a joy! You always defend me! How many times in the great and small circumstances, would someone injure me and he took my defense! I must always beg him that it was enough and he should not give contrary evidence to those who accused me.

With his strength, I work; it is he who works and acts in his Work. //

The oil blessed by the Eternal Father

The tribulations are without comparison. While I was in the church, after the thanksgiving, I was weeping and I said to my Eternal Father to send me his Providence. He appeared to me so beautifully, that I was enchanted, and he clearly told me that he would take care of everything which is necessary for his Work. I had many illustrations and special explanations on what I must do, very clear lights which made me see the most secret things.

I suffered much for some weaknesses I saw yesterday evening when I was in my poor room. While I prayed, I was absorbed: I saw the Eternal Father who blessed the oil I kept on my table which would be used to cure the diseases. Are they coming soon, my Good? He did not reply; he only said that I could use it for the next day for // some sick people. I promised him that I would do everything; what he said came to be true.

A holy soul appeared to me. I said to it: If it is true that you are a saint, obtain for me, from my Good such grace, I even added another one. About the first, it said: “You have it already and soon you will see it.” When I asked about the other one, it ran away. Then I beseeched it anxiously, but it said nothing. My Good, do you not give answer to my prayers? A voice said to me! “Keep what you have.” This referred to the grace I mentioned above. Oh, I realize that you do not want to grant me anything!

In this way, I spent the night in pain, but such night was terrible because it seemed that in my room I had a revolution.

Oh, what blows on the table, on the kneeling-stool! How could I sleep? Oh, I could never take it! In the morning I felt very weak, because the enemy had shaken me very much. My

God, how beautiful, indescribable // things I was taught about hidden things which will happen in his Institute. He showed me the terrible pains I was to go through in a short time. Today, I started what my Good told me some days ago. The sufferings are horrible. But because of the grace my Good gave me to conceal them before people, no one was aware at all about the horrible state in which I was. What cruel afflictions! Under the lashes of suffering, my soul delights because my Love holds me tight to him and he enraptures me. What I feel and enjoy is without equal. My side, what a fire! Alas, I am dying, I cannot bear it anymore! Many times I make an act of contrition, and then I abandon myself to God, saying: Let him do with me what pleases him. I feared nothing grasping my Love, I felt like dying. Oh, let me die; I cannot bear it anymore. //

“Providence” for the foundation of Sampierdarena

I was praying for Providence: my cloud appeared to me, and this time inside it, I saw a beautiful lady who had much gold. I seemed that I possessed it. A voice said to me: “You will use it for Piacenza.” I answered her: “It would be dearer to buy the house of Sampierdarena which I need most.” She disappeared. Who could she be? Meanwhile, I was feeling the fire on the side of the heart that was growing horribly and I was not able to bear it. My God, alas, I die! It is very good and of great comfort for me, that Jesus my Beloved, not only suggests me what I should say, but still holds back the word if it is not good that I say it. This thing, or rather this action of my Beloved upon my words comforts me very much in these great confusions and immense tribulations. //

“Those particles are not consecrated”

One morning, I went for Holy Communion in a church in Genoa. While the priest turned with the ciborium in the hand I saw next to me a troop of devils; soon I was disturbed. My God, perhaps I did not prepare well and I am not worthy to receive you! Certainly, I will never be worthy, but your goodness covers my iniquity. Alas, in a flash all these things were repeated in my confused mind. As the priest came closer, a voice said to me: “Those particles are not consecrated.” I was so confused and did not know if I had to remain or to go away, because there were other people before me at the altar. Meanwhile, the priest was closer and I received: I was taken by much grief, annoyed, frightened, confused and weeping: Jesus where are you?

Therefore, am I deprived of you, my Love? A voice said to me: “Be calm, that for you it is consecrated; I put in it my Body and Blood, do not fear.”37

Oh, I was very happy in union with my Love. I felt the peace of paradise for many days. Those // days being of great sorrow, how much consolation he gave me!

Meaning of the invisible stigmata

Alas! Now that the exterior tribulations ceased a bit, the interior ones started: doubts, diabolic words and at the end an abyss of pains which I cannot describe. Pain without compare! My cloud came to comfort me: Oh, my Love, if you could delay to come, I would die of sorrow! It was an ecstasy; I was transported to converse with my Being who was in the cloud. He instructed me on many things, he showed me many things which will happen, he showed me my hands, the feet and the heart, what was in them and the power they give me. Leaning to any other suffering, the great grace which I always had, that of being indifferent to praises would disappear. They even caused me restlessness and suffering. It is true that I did not feel them, because the pains and torments absorbed them all, and in this way, they gave me boredom. // The graces which I receive continually cannot be numbered.

12 October: Alas, my Love, leave me for pity’s sake. Otherwise, I will die. I cannot bear it! And I fainted. I saw nothing. Some moments I felt something was approaching, I do not know how to express it, and I delighted. In other moments there was the dear Child. Holding him tightly I felt enraptured from the side of the heart: I do not know how he did it. Oh, what I felt when I went to the church to receive my Love! Oh, my Love, why are you making me feel so great and matchless! Oh, paradise, if it continues like this I will come, my Beloved; this fire burns me and consumes me. Oh, my Love, I feel like dying every moment; I will grasp you soon! But no, to suffer for you my Love! “Who has not tasted the joy of suffering, does not know what delight means”

I was in the opening of a new house in this beloved Work of St. Anne. I saw many great and beautiful things. Some were confusing, others seemed to me as if they foretold to // me to the great tribulations which I would suffer in this house.

Today my hands, what a pain! But the pleasure is without equal; how much pleasure I felt! Certainly one who has not tasted the joy of suffering does not know what delight means.

One morning while a devout priest was celebrating Mass, I put myself in the chalice asking the Eternal Father to have the kindness to look at me, telling him that I was covered by the Blood of my Love Jesus, and submerged in it. On the altar of the sacrifice there are two victims, look at us! And saying this I was absorbed in God and remained so. He let me see that he had accepted that offering of sacrifice with great pleasure. Oh, my Love, you are pleased with so little! But it is not like that for the thankless human beings; for so little, you reward them with treasures without equal, while the creatures repay you with ingratitude.

Vision of the Saviour.

A dream of the Blessed Virgin Mary

Date 19 October: Suddenly // my Saviour appeared to me all dressed with a radiant mantle. He kept an empty golden chalice in his hand. He bent it towards me as if to show me that it was empty and then he disappeared. I said nothing. I remained with my mind on him and I thought only of him. My Love, how much love towards one who is full of demerits! The next day, I hardly started my meditation when I was absorbed in my Good and had nothing but love: my soul delighted, my intellect was supplied by the most beautiful cognitions and lights. Many times I remain very cold, I do not even think. Then a bright light appears to me that clears up my mind and opens my intellect. Soon I find my Good, my Love.

Yesterday, while I was writing, I concentrated. A strong fire was burning on the side of my heart that I could not bear.

As I recovered, I hurried to bathe // which relieved me a bit.

I was to take a rest when a strong and affectionate thought towards St. Joseph pervaded me. What is it? And I slept, or rather, I fell into a spiritual trance. I found myself in a huge church where many religious women and others were on the main altar that was illuminated. I saw the Blessed Virgin

Mary with the Child in her arms. The splendor was such that it is impossible to describe. It seemed to me that all of them saw and felt as I did, that it was a paradise of sweetness.

Interiorly, I felt great things as if I heard them spoken. Then it seemed to me that I said to all those people: Oh, how beautiful is Mary! I fainted and a voice said to me: “That vision is only for you; great troubles and struggles without compare await you.”

These words were so impressed on me that, recovered from the drowse, I said: Alas, // therefore soon I have to fight with the creatures who will cause me evil regarding his Work! I saw some Daughters of St .Anne who have very little spirit of God and their vocation was in bad state. Horrible thing! But I prayed much for them that the saint told me: “No one will fall into evil things and I will not allow that they give the least scandal.” I offered myself as a victim in sacrifice, to make sure that at least until I die no one may commit disgraceful things. She accepted willingly my sacrifice and assured me that it would never happen.

Odor of incense. Taste of blood

For various days I felt someone close to me, but I saw nothing. I only felt that this person incensed me. What can it be? Some sisters came into this room where I am writing for his Work and some of them said: “Oh, what a nice odor, it seems // they are giving the benediction!” Others said: “We feel nothing.” I was calm; others came and said: “What a nice odor of incense; who burned it?” Some other sisters answered: “No one.” I continued my work pretending not to care; I did not understand why not all of them felt it. I asked but I got no reply.

For more than three days, I was in a certain way which I do not know how to express: I cannot pray. Everything is heavy; I carry the weight with difficulty. Only today, after receiving Holy Communion, I felt a taste of blood as if I had my mouth full of it. I had a long thanksgiving and when I stood up, I saw that long a time had passed while I felt it was a minute. Oh, my Love, how time runs when one stays with you! I do not know how to express how I remained; I would say that my thanksgiving…//

Heavenly consolations and diabolic assaults

25 October: From eleven pm until four am I stayed in ecstasy. Recovered, my first words were: My Love you are killing me! I remained lifeless, without strength; I cannot express how the side of the heart was. Alas, I am dying, what exhaustion! In this way abandoned on the floor I slept peacefully as if I was on a bed of feathers. When I woke up, happy, I was feeling sensibly whatever I experienced in the morning, full of knowledge of God and assurance on my doubts. Among the many things I saw and heard, one was that soon there will be a creature who would give great help to the Work of my Good.

28 March: I was attacked by the infernal enemy; alone in my room I heard what sounded like wind and there was a diabolic legion that came in and so many things it did to me!

// The stuff it showed me was horrible. I held tightly my Crucifix, but I could hardly say a word, a prayer with difficulty. But, how? The spirits did not allow me. However, all that infamy disturbed me for nothing. They raged always more angrily; but with the help of my God I invoked Jesus and Mary and ordered the spirits to leave. The cruelest thing was that they forcefully wanted to enter into my intellect and there to form unhappy images; but they did not manage because they had to run away.

This struggle left me very depressed and my poor mind in disorder. A severe headache gave me terrible pains. Much strength is needed to resist such cruel assault! You, my Good, who provided me with great strength, you can say how much suffering this battle caused me.

I suffered much for having seen a small fault that a Daughter of St. Anne committed // and how through it she offended God. I felt a torment without equal. Dear Eternal

Father, if for something so small I feel such a pain for the offence made to Jesus, what if I could see the grave ones!

Alas, I think I could not resist the sorrow. Ah, for pity’s sake, never allow that these daughters commit grave sin, no, no.

This morning I had beautiful lessons; since I was very disturbed, because I was afraid of having failed in something

  • it was true, unintentionally - but I always thought about it:

is it true? Yes? No? Examination over examination, but I saw nothing positive; the worst is that when I wanted to examine my conscience everything was disappearing from my mind and I was not able to gather anything. The doubts grew stronger. My Love, do you leave me like this? Alas, a crowd of diabolic suggestions, // whispered to me that I fell in a state of little reflection and imperfection because of the lack of a guide. Now, finally I understood: I will end up without realizing, and will fall into desolation because there is no remedy for me. I wanted to force myself but it was not possible; I had continuous new diabolic suggestions. My voice said to me – after leaving me experience the cruelest of torments, that of having displeased my Love – “Be serene, nothing is true, the aridity, the talk is all diabolic action; do not be afraid.”

He explained to me why I was so depressed: I wanted to reason very much and do things on my own. He let me do them for a while, but he was always close to me. Oh, my Love! “It pleased me to leave you for my rightful purposes.” In addition, he said: “Look, what I allowed you to feel for that small failure was so, that you could // consider if you felt so much for others, you would feel it much more for yourself.” These last words were said so clearly that they gave me peace and assurance and in this way everything vanished. I remained arid and with nothing, but I had no unrest and fear. If in a moment my Good would not flash his light for a second with certain brief raptures, I would not live in these days of purging my enormous iniquities. My Love, how merciful you are that you forget so quickly what I do. Oh, my dear Love!

Beautiful lessons given by the Lord

On the nights of eleven and twelve June 1874, there was a continuous procession of beasts that crawled along the wall where I was sleeping. Some were big, others a bit smaller and instead of being black they were grey. One of those big ones moved so slowly that I thought of touching it // and picking it; I did this without reflection. I was already with my hand suspended but soon I stopped; my God, what am I doing? Immediately I understood that, it was that monster that had driven me to do so; because being unable to come closer to me, it would have liked that I touch it for curiosity’s sake. Soon, I realized it because of God’s mercy. Oh, yes, my Good, you must be careful with me as with a child. How much goodness! The beasts did not give me much trouble, but they did not allow me to sleep. When I slept they shook my bed and woke me up.

Oh, how many beautiful lessons I received from the Being of my life! I was dealing with an affair of his Work and apparently there was nothing visible that could be spoiled. Seeing nothing, what did I do? I threw myself as a child in the arms of my Eternal Father and I said to him: I know nothing. You speak, you act, and I will always walk following your words and your steps. // In this way, I stayed fully in my God, I delighted greatly: if people who do not believe could have seen me, they could certainly admire what a great and unthinkable thing God does in so small and abject creature. Oh, admirable incomprehensible cooperation! For I who am ignorant, it is impossible to describe what has been passing through. Everything was settled! He spoke and made me understand and said: “She is not a woman but a man.” Oh, foolish! I am ignorant like you, as the whole world is. Oh, if human beings could understand and see what my Good does, they would certainly be converted and would serve him better!

But, on Friday what did I feel? I can say I was in ecstasy for the whole day. Oh, what pain to see myself on this earth again! But what am I saying, my Good! To live, to give you // pleasure through my sufferings. I had to force myself and listen to those who wanted my attention about the affairs of the Work and act because there was extreme need. But what a pain, my Good, to turn aside from you; otherwise soon I could be enraptured in you! If he was strong, I escaped carefully; but because of his promise and for the strength he gave me, no one was able to realize.

There was a matter of laughter. Unfortunately, I was unable to retire early because of so much work, and I was supposed to be the first to animate the others. But what did the fool do? It never allowed me to talk on matters of my Good, nothing, all foolishness. Oh, it was a long time that I lived like this. It was not me who lived but my Good lived for me.

Jesus: “I share in your afflictions”

Today, 15 July: I am in a horrible state. I do not know where my Good left me. Oh, cruel thought, // my Being must have been lost.

It is almost a month, since I have had a minute to write, but my suffering was horrendous.

It is 5 August 1874. Yesterday morning I was in the very painful despair for being always deprived of my Love. With heart broken I went on repeating: I love you, I love you, and don’t you love me anymore? Did you run away because I am a monster? And I heaped all the penances upon myself as much as I could. Where are you? Have mercy on me, my Good. I would have liked to be always alone to weep; it is only at night that I am alone and I can give vent. But it grew worst.

On 8 August, I looked at the image of my Jesus, the Sacred Heart, and I saw him serious, gloomy. I turned to the Holy Mother St. Anne; she was the same. Yesterday, after having received him with such suffering I told him: My Love, what did I do // that you do not love me anymore? I asked if I had committed something that displeased him and could have been the cause for abandoning me. Oh, certainly there is a creature that you love more than me, because she is better than me! I heard a loud: No! And nothing more! That was enough for me to be in peace and calm, to return to live. I was not able to say anything immediately because I was as in ecstasy. After, I said: Why are you so sorrowful and gloomy? He answered: “I share in your afflictions.” I was unable to understand because I had many and always the usual. I said: What grave thing will happen? Nothing will give me pain, even the cruelest, because the only thing which can bring me agony is when I lose you my Love with my evil actions. With you a thousand hells are few. // Yes, I see well that very sorrowful things will happen to me because some very big beasts always stroll in my room, and they are a sure sign. Many times I experienced it and also Jesus told me that they have certainly worked out to instigate one another; and finding some one who gives them heed, they act in such a way as to demonstrate things in their own way. Everything is allowed by my God.

Ghosts and night beasts

One night, tired, I said to myself: I will put off the lamp in order not to see them anymore and avoid feeling bad impressions. That was what I did; I put off the lamp. Alas, I put it on quickly: they were roaring as wild animals, what a fright! I never stayed in the dark anymore. Once when I was on a visit, I had to sleep in a bed. In the same room there were also two sisters. I lay down dressed and they put off // the lamp. What did the ugly monster do? It came and lay upon my hand. Oh, I will always remember it; it was cold as a marble! I cried and jumped out of the bed. All were frightened and asked what the matter was. A beast! I answered. They thought that it was a common beast and soon they started searching on all corners; I let them search so that they would not think something else. Actually I had screamed very loudly. I was half-asleep and I did not think about keeping quiet. It was a very natural reaction. I only asked them to leave the lamp on for me; I was never in the dark anymore.

In this way, I had no more fear. However, interiorly I felt horrendous tribulations were going to happen. Then I suffered much because interiorly I felt what they mean and many times I was discouraged; // it seemed as if I had been sick for the whole night, and it is like that because I suffer much. Sometimes the beasts made odd strolls. They ran or they remained crowded, stationary and then they disappeared. On the 2nd of August, the eve of certain very cruel tribulations, my Love supported me in a special way.

He caressed, me telling me that he was taking part in my tribulations of that night. Oh, what type of beasts! New shapes and all with a long tail: some dressed and others naked, some ran and some others wanted to come upon me. The wall of my poor room was dark: on one side, one ran after the other; they produced in me the interior feeling of deep sorrow and the breathlessness which left me exhausted. If this would have not happened to me, then there could have been a funny comedy.

SECOND RREPORT

MS Booklet 1, Part II, pp. 1-122

It seems that Mother Rosa started to write this second notebook at the beginning of 1871, stating beforehand the remembrance of numerous important moments of her spiritual itinerary beginning from 1864, the year of the first great infused enlightenments, while she was still in Genoa.

Then the years of Piacenza, of Cento and Sampierdarena from1868 to1870 follow during which two difficult moments leave a painful impression on the spirit of the Foundress: the judiciary action against her and against Father Tornatore by the priest Angelo Ricchini caused by the house of Sampierdarena and much more the humiliation she suffered on 31 March 1868 from Father Tornatore, because he believed the unfounded accusations of the superior of the Mother House. She is silent on the other sufferings of the years 1868 and 1869, “an artificial fire from all sides.”

From January 1871 Mother Rosa entrusts to the paper her intimate experiences, with certain continuity but still at irregular intervals. She lives alternatively days and above all nights, of great consolations and flames of love and with others of terrible torments such as: abandonment of God, temptations even of desperation, malicious suggestions, night ghosts…

In another exercise book starting from 1872 she notes down her sufferings as a foundress and the way she lived in her spirit the events of the Constitutions, while she continues to express through her pen the more intense moments of her mission of “suffering and delight” lived in the following years until 1878.
